title: Add inspirations in bulk
subtitle: Select multiple images, preview them, and save them to your collection in one batch.
dropHint: JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF, HEIC and HEIF are supported. You can select multiple images.
previewHint: Review the previews, then save all images at once.
previewFailed: This image couldn't be previewed. Remove it and choose a valid image.
uploadFailed: Upload failed. Check your connection and try again.
readyToUpload: Each image will be saved as a separate inspiration.
waitBeforeLeaving: Images are still being prepared or uploaded. Wait for the batch to finish before leaving.
